prompts.fortuneness-mark: Create one original square brand-mark illustration for Fortuneness, a calm premium tarot-reflection iPhone and iPad app. Design a simple centered celestial sigil: a moon-silver crescent cradling an antique-gold eight-point dawn star above a subtle arched doorway or horizon, with two restrained symmetrical botanical flourishes and a few tiny constellation dots. Use midnight indigo and near-black violet as the field, with deep teal, muted amethyst, moon silver, antique gold, and very restrained parchment highlights. The mark must feel mysterious, serene, trustworthy, inclusive, and modern while retaining a refined Art Nouveau line language. Compose as a strict 1:1 square icon with strong silhouette, generous safe margins for iOS icon masking, no tiny essential details, no transparency, and high legibility at 32 pixels. Do not include a card frame or a human figure. Produce symbol only: no title, no letters, no words, no typography, no logo text, no signature, and no watermark. Do not imitate any named artist.
